Name: Player ID
notes: Stable unique id for the human. Never reuse. Named characters will not use this id; they will belong to a force.

Name: Display Name
notes: The human at the table, not the model. Do not use this as a warlord identity.

Name: Status
notes: Only active players can be assigned to games.

Name: Role
notes: Marshals resolve map disputes. Admins edit schema/data.

Name: Allegiance
notes: Political side. Players are Loyalist or Traitor only. Blackshields is a force type on db_forces, not a third side. The value needs side is a migration flag until an admin assigns a side. It is not an allegiance, and that player's forces do not count until then.

Name: Starting System
notes: Personal HQ / where they join the map. Force tokens have their own sys_id.

Name: Notes
notes: Logistics and house-rule notes. Not army lore.
